final_message: Added `specdojo update` (`--to`, `--dry-run`, `--no-interactive`) under `src/update/` and `src/commands/update.ts`, with 35 unit tests in `tests/src/update/`. Added the `update` section to command-reference and upgrade notes to the Quick Start guide and README. Updated the ticket's work table, results (including the CHANGELOG reading decision and the CHANGELOG draft), and related documents. Row 5 (orchestrator verification with a real 0.9.1 install and an npm pack tarball) stays open. The real tar/npm calls in `src/update/system.ts` have not been run because the sandbox did not allow the smoke test.
handoff: Work table row 5 is still open: after integration, the orchestrator should install npm specdojo 0.9.1 in an empty repository, run `config scaffold --provider claude`, then run `specdojo update --to <npm pack tarball>`. Check the version update, the CHANGELOG output, detection and interactive application of the stale skill copies, and that `--no-interactive` rewrites nothing.
The real tar / npm view / npm pack calls in `src/update/system.ts` have not been run (the sandbox did not allow the smoke test). The row 5 check covers this path.
CHANGELOG.md was not changed. The draft entry (category: 追加) is in the ticket under `### 5.1. CHANGELOG に書く事項`.

CHANGELOG reading time: read the new version's CHANGELOG from the package extracted to a temp dir before the update. The same content can be shown in `--dry-run`, and the extracted package also serves as the comparison source. Cost: one extra tarball fetch.

_UNDECIDED_: whether to propose rewrites of config files. The first version only shows the related CHANGELOG lines. A possible approach (ship machine-readable migration declarations per version and ask with a diff) is recorded in the ticket.
No protected configuration change (`package.json`, `lefthook.yml`) was needed.
